blocks.html: Sixthly, two other witnesses depose that a soldier from Rochefort, not long ago, passed through the place of Artigat, who, astonished to see the said du Tilh call himself Martin Guerre, said aloud that he was a trickster: for Martin Guerre was in Flanders, having only one leg, and the other of wood, for having lost the one from a cannon-shot before Saint-Quentin, on St Lawrence's day.
